html:
G'oya

Uch qadam. Birinchisi, har bir ijarachi uchun oylar kalendari: ko'chib kirgan oydan 2024-06 gacha. Bu rekursiv CTE, har qadamda bir oy qo'shiladi. Ikkinchisi, to'lovlarni oy bo'yicha yig'ib, kalendarga LEFT JOIN qilish: to'lovsiz oy 0 bilan qoladi. Uchinchisi, qarz: har oy rent - paid qo'shiladi, buni o'sib boruvchi SUM(...) OVER beradi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH RECURSIVE cal(tenant_id, m) AS (
  SELECT id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', moved_in) AS DATE) FROM tenants
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tenant_id, CAST(m + INTERVAL '1 month' AS DATE) FROM cal
  WHERE m < DATE '2024-06-01'
),
paid AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_on) AS DATE) AS m, SUM(amount) AS paid
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY tenant_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_on) AS DATE)
)
SELECT c.tenant_id, TO_CHAR(c.m, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       COALESCE(p.paid, 0) AS paid,
       SUM(t.rent - COALESCE(p.paid, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.tenant_id ORDER BY c.m) AS debt
FROM cal c
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.m = c.m
ORDER BY c.tenant_id, c.m

Kalendar 2024-06 da to'xtaydi, shuning uchun iyuldagi to'lovlar hech qaysi oyga ulanmaydi va hisobga kirmaydi. Malikaning mayi: 3 000 000 to'langan, ijara 2 500 000, qarz -500 000, ya'ni avans. Iyunda u 2 000 000 to'laydi va qarz yana 0.

Tuzoqlar

Kalendarni ko'chib kirgan kundan boshlamang, oy boshidan boshlang. SQLite'da date('2024-01-31', '+1 month') 2-mart beradi va Malikaning fevrali kalendardan tushib qoladi:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE cal(tenant_id, m) AS (
  SELECT id, moved_in FROM tenants
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tenant_id, date(m, '+1 month') FROM cal
  WHERE date(m, 'start of month') < '2024-06-01'
)
SELECT tenant_id, strftime('%Y-%m', m) AS month FROM cal ORDER BY tenant_id, m

SUM(t.rent - p.paid) da COALESCE bo'lmasa, to'lovsiz oy uchun ayirma NULL, SUM esa NULL ni tashlab yuboradi. Natijada to'lanmagan oyning ijarasi qarzga umuman qo'shilmaydi.

Kalendarsiz, faqat to'lov bor oylar bo'yicha hisoblasangiz, Bekzod natijada umuman bo'lmaydi.

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da oy boshi date(d, 'start of month'), keyingi oy date(m, '+1 month'). Oy boshidan bir oy qo'shish ikkala bazada ham xavfsiz:

Faqat SQLiteWITH RECURSIVE cal(tenant_id, m) AS (
  SELECT id, date(moved_in, 'start of month') FROM tenants
  UNION ALL
  SELECT tenant_id, date(m, '+1 month') FROM cal
  WHERE m < '2024-06-01'
),
paid AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, date(paid_on, 'start of month') AS m, SUM(amount) AS paid
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY tenant_id, date(paid_on, 'start of month')
)
SELECT c.tenant_id, strftime('%Y-%m', c.m) AS month,
       COALESCE(p.paid, 0) AS paid,
       SUM(t.rent - COALESCE(p.paid, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.tenant_id ORDER BY c.m) AS debt
FROM cal c
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.m = c.m
ORDER BY c.tenant_id, c.m
